description: Current and former leaders of ITACUBE, the nanosatellite initiative of the Instituto Tecnológico de Aeronáutica (ITA), Brazil. We design, build and operate small satellites, and bring skills in SAR and optical remote sensing, geospatial data, hydrology, predictive modelling, web development, UX design and science communication. With IARA, we turn NISAR radar data into maps and stories about mining, floods and drought in the Amazon, for the communities and agencies that face them.
